claims: Jon Scheyer is the head coach of the Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team.
Jon Scheyer has held the position of head coach since the 2022-23 season.
Jon Scheyer assumed the head coach position following the retirement of Mike Krzyzewski.
Jon Scheyer was a Duke player from 2006 to 2010.
Jon Scheyer previously served on the Duke staff as an assistant and associate head coach.
Jon Scheyer took over as head coach in April 2021.
Jon Scheyer took over as head coach officially for the 2022-23 season.
Jon Scheyer helped lead Duke to a national championship as a player in 2010.
Jon Scheyer became the first person to win an ACC Tournament title as both a player and a coach.
Mike Krzyzewski was with the program for 42 years.
